entities.name: Pie Eugène Joseph Neveu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pie Eugène Joseph Neveu was a French Roman Catholic bishop. He was a member of the Assumptionists and was ordained a priest in 1905. He arrived in Russia in 1907 and remained there until 1936, serving as the Apostolic Administrator of Moscow from 1926 after being consecrated as a bishop. Neveu was appointed to the titular see of Citrus.

entities.summary: Pie Eugène Joseph Neveu was a French Roman Catholic bishop. He was a member of the Assumptionists and was ordained a priest in 1905. He arrived in Russia in 1907 and remained there until 1936, serving as the Apostolic Administrator of Moscow from 1926 after being consecrated as a bishop. Neveu was appointed to the titular see of Citrus.
